_note: coxlm's general-behaviour check: short texts with one question each, whose answers are unambiguous from the text. coxlm.finetune asks these before and after a fine-tune and warns when accuracy drops, a sign the adapter changed more than the task it was trained on. The texts and labels were written by Claude (Anthropic) for this purpose. They are a held-out sanity check only: never use them as training data.
